work_packages.title: Bind the repair to available sources
work_packages.operation: Use the existing snapshot/manuscript document as the sole prose base; record the absent-source limitation in the derivative status report. Inventory recovered material only if supplied and authorized.
work_packages.expected: Every later revision is attributable to actual sources and does not imply unseen Chapter 2 coverage.
acceptance: Original-source hashes still match.
Chapter 2 and image absence remain explicit.
No new source is imported without reviewed usage and provenance.
work_packages.risk: A recovered source could require a new plan version.
work_packages.preserve: Original files and all prior audit versions.

work_packages.title: Adopt explicit identity and reference-text choices
work_packages.stage: Phase 4 text planning; visual derivatives in Phase 5
work_packages.owner: manga-canon-manager for proposed facts; manga-revision-planner for edits
work_packages.operation: Prepare proposed identity and physical-state records using the selected recommendations. Use them in new derivative text only after approval; do not merge disputed IDs silently.
work_packages.expected: Names, clocks, clothing, and object states agree across new text artifacts.
acceptance: Lilia and Arturo have one approved textual identity each.
Legacy alternative labels remain traceable as conflicts.
Clock identities and placement are unambiguous.
No original character/reference text is overwritten.
work_packages.risk: Unseen images may later need a separate reconciliation plan.
work_packages.preserve: Adult silhouettes, occupational detail, chosen-family role, and civic antagonist.

work_packages.title: Resolve the hatch, overlap, and transfer model
work_packages.operation: Prepare one coherent text rule sheet and movement ledger for the recommended physical model; record what is source-supported and what is a proposed addition.
work_packages.expected: Chapter 1 can show safe exchanges and a bounded after-closure reply without moving a person through time.
acceptance: Each man remains within his own era while reaching the hatch.
Ruined and restored objects have explicit sides.
The reply crosses before closure and falls free later.
Two paper objects remain separate.
Protection does not create an unlimited fresh-object loophole.
work_packages.risk: Clarifying mechanics can overexplain a lyrical scene; keep the rule sheet private and prose changes minimal.
work_packages.preserve: Sensory miracle, narrow window, dangerous wrist contact, safe fingertips, and returned-note reveal.

work_packages.title: Specify the calendar and cost boundaries for continuation
work_packages.stage: Phase 4 baseline; exact schedule before any continuation
work_packages.operation: Document the intact first meeting, paired-day recommendation, and distinction between elapsed minutes and lost capacity. Reserve exact dates, penalty calibration, and recovery for a separate proposed continuation rule table before they enter prose.
work_packages.expected: The repaired opening makes no unsupported permanent-loss or fire-deadline claim.
acceptance: Chapter 1 retains 12:00-12:07.
Tomas's October 17 statement is preserved.
No exact date for Daniel or fire date is silently added.
No later chapter is drafted until its calendar, intervention cost, and evidence model are explicitly approved.
work_packages.risk: A long outline may require a different calendar; that must produce a new proposal rather than a silent exception.

work_packages.title: Restore causal knowledge and investigation sequence
work_packages.stage: Phase 4 manuscript; adapted dialogue in Phase 5
work_packages.owner: manga-chapter-writer and manga-dialogue-writer after required approvals
work_packages.operation: Plan localized changes to the visit motive, guessed year, suspect inquiry, question/response chain, and knowledge ledger. Restore introductions and the signal clue when adapting the approved prose. Preserve an explicit future comparison obligation for the photograph.
work_packages.expected: Every conclusion follows evidence available to its speaker; the final warning increases danger without proving murder.
acceptance: Late access has one approved reason.
1986 is a hypothesis until confirmed.
The name is learned before it is recognized on glass.
The broker and signal are both investigated as leads, not convictions.
Daniel does not know a proved death or arson from the scratch alone.
The photo is not silently assigned contents.
work_packages.risk: Added bridges could crowd banter; offset by selective trimming only where meaning is redundant.
work_packages.preserve: Opening line, dry corrections, mutual introductions, untouched-coffee clue, and ending order.

work_packages.title: Build independent goals and witness knowledge
work_packages.stage: Phase 4 architecture proposals; later development before continuation
work_packages.operation: Prepare goal/knowledge/cost proposals from existing work and chosen-family relationships. Identify who witnessed versus inferred each clue. Do not insert unapproved trauma or secret notebook contents.
work_packages.expected: Tomas can make a choice Daniel must respect; every witness has an independent reason to act or stay silent.
acceptance: Tomas has an independent proposed goal and a possible rescue conflict.
Daniel's growth is expressed as behavior, not an invented bereavement.
All witness facts are marked observed, reported, inferred, or proposed.
No unsupported character voice is treated as an existing dialogue sample.
work_packages.risk: A larger cast can inflate the opening; most material belongs to future approved architecture, not Chapter 1 exposition.
work_packages.preserve: Tomas's present initiative, Lilia's chosen-family warmth, and Maribel's competence.

work_packages.title: Define a revelation ladder and scope checkpoints
work_packages.stage: Phase 4 architecture proposal, not additional chapter drafting
work_packages.operation: Use existing Arc 1 titles to propose distinct knowledge, agency, danger, or relationship changes. Treat the first three chapters as a development checkpoint and later arcs as conditional proposals. Distinguish a repeated motif from a repeated first discovery.
work_packages.expected: The existing long-series ambition has staged commitments rather than filler obligations.
acceptance: Each proposed early chapter changes at least one meaningful state.
Chapter 5's pastry and Arc 2's false archive material add something beyond Chapter 1.
Arc 3 and Arc 6 do not simply reveal Arc 1's culprit/fire again.
Any memory change preserves consequences and mutual choice.
Other cafes remain deferred until their necessity is demonstrated.
work_packages.risk: Scope may reduce or vary chapter counts; no original titles or arc folders are changed without explicit approval.
work_packages.preserve: Daniel and Tomas as the center and San Aurelio as the anchor.

work_packages.title: Set reader, content, and release boundaries
work_packages.stage: Phase 3 proposal; adoption only by user
work_packages.operation: Review the creative brief and success plan: provisional audience/rating, unnamed-country boundary, preferred hopeful outcome, sustainable scope, offline feedback conditions, and publication assumptions.
work_packages.expected: Production and audience decisions are intentional and distinguish hypotheses from evidence.
acceptance: No country, historical accuracy, formal rating, commercial demand, or IP clearance is claimed without evidence.
Reader and capacity metrics are defined but not fabricated as measured.
No sharing, payment, release, or research is executed by this plan.
work_packages.risk: Real reader or capacity evidence may change the recommended scope.
work_packages.preserve: Adult queer dignity, cultural texture, author control, and creator-health boundaries.

work_packages.title: Apply approved repairs to a new Chapter 1 version
work_packages.stage: Phase 4, blocked until plan, relevant decisions, and exact change-set approval
work_packages.operation: Prepare an exact proposed change set against hashed source units, then after its approval create a separate Chapter 1 manuscript version. Keep title, core sequence, relationship exchanges, and ending order. Trim only repetitions that do not change state or meaning.
work_packages.expected: A recognizable, causally clearer opening with no source overwrite.
acceptance: Every edit has an issue ID, source-unit target, and an approved change set.
The original first line and three anchor exchanges remain recognizable.
No forced new chapter split or cliffhanger is introduced.
Both analytical scenes retain a meaningful state change.
The new manuscript remains unapproved until separately reviewed.
work_packages.risk: Mechanical repair can flatten voice; reject changes that explain what an action already makes clear.
work_packages.preserve: Paper-worldview voice, museum humor, bread joke, I am real reciprocity, and better-bread reply.

work_packages.title: Verify differences, continuity, and approvals
work_packages.operation: Produce deterministic diffs and an issue disposition matrix distinguishing fixed, proposed, deferred, and not applicable. Check original hashes, knowledge, time, props, relationships, source locators, and voice anchors. Present the manuscript for review.
work_packages.expected: Every audit finding remains accounted for; future-production issues are not falsely marked resolved by prose edits.
acceptance: All 30 issues have a disposition and evidence of the current state.
Deferred items retain owners and prerequisites.
No original or approved audit bytes change.
No manuscript or story lock is activated by a validation result.
Exact diff/review package is presented before manuscript approval.
work_packages.risk: A technical pass cannot prove emotional success; use author review and authorized reader checks as separate evidence.
work_packages.preserve: Source traceability, explicit uncertainty, and separate approvals.

work_packages.title: Reconcile legacy scripts after story approval
work_packages.operation: Create new script versions from the approved manuscript, using legacy scripts only as comparison. Restore causal dialogue, correct identities, and redistribute events by reading pressure rather than preserving every five/six-panel page.
work_packages.expected: A story-faithful, clearly readable proposed adaptation.
acceptance: Introductions and connective questions precede responses.
All clue captions match character knowledge.
The fifteen-title arc envelope does not dictate a uniform panel count.
Text corrections remain separate from artwork and original prompts.
work_packages.risk: Fourteen pages may no longer be the best allocation; page count is a proposal until approved.
work_packages.preserve: Strong existing images and quiet reaction beats.

work_packages.title: Specify readable preproduction and SFX
work_packages.stage: Phase 5 only, after required story approvals and locks
work_packages.operation: Prepare event-driven page intents, explicit reading sequence, geometry-only nemu, one dominant panel event, motivated camera directions, dialogue-safe areas, and complete SFX fields.
work_packages.expected: A reviewable storyboard and lettering plan ready for appropriate preproduction checks.
acceptance: Every SFX has source, reader meaning, intensity, English language, translation context, and lettering intent.
Every panel has one dominant event.
All dynamic layouts have a stated narrative reason.
Reading order and text-space checks pass before artwork handoff.
work_packages.risk: No current image exists to validate rendered clarity; a planning score cannot confer approval.
work_packages.preserve: Rain and clock soundscape, silence at closure, and deliberate negative space.

work_packages.title: Prepare gated ChatGPT handoffs
work_packages.operation: After all required approvals and locks, create structured jobs for needed references and later panels/covers. Release dependent jobs only with actual approved hash-locked references and deterministic Markdown attachment checklists.
work_packages.expected: External ChatGPT handoffs satisfy the high-quality contract and have no invented reference paths.
acceptance: No image is generated, edited, or retouched by Codex.
Panel artwork jobs forbid dialogue, captions, balloons, SFX text, borders, page numbers, signatures, watermarks, and color.
All attachment paths exist and hashes match approvals.
A pending reference blocks only its dependent jobs; no fallback prompt is called an approved reference.
work_packages.risk: Reference turnaround and revisions can change schedule; measure them before public commitments.
work_packages.preserve: Distinct adult designs and the user's complete artwork prohibition.
